entries.term: I'm a full-stack engineer with ... years of experience.
entries.zh: 我是一名有……年经验的全栈工程师。

examples.en: I'm a full-stack engineer with about ten years of experience, mostly in e-commerce and payments.
examples.zh: 我是一名全栈工程师，有大约十年经验，主要做电商和支付。

situation.zh: 面试官说：先简单介绍一下你自己吧。
situation.en: Sure. I'm a full-stack engineer with ten years of experience, and I currently lead the checkout team at an e-commerce company.

entries.note: 开场一句话说清身份和年限，后面再展开，不要从大学讲起。

entries.zh: 最近这一段（经历），两个词，m 开头

examples.en: Most recently, I've been leading the migration of our monolith to services.
examples.zh: 最近这段时间，我在主导把我们的单体应用拆成服务。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你最近这份工作主要在做什么？
situation.en: Most recently, I've been working on the payments platform, where I own the checkout flow.

entries.note: 讲经历时按时间倒序，从最近的讲起，用它开头很自然。

entries.zh: 我的背景主要是……方面（b 开头的名词）

examples.en: My background is in backend systems, but I've done a lot of React work over the last three years.
examples.zh: 我的背景是后端系统，不过最近三年也做了很多 React 开发。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你更偏前端还是后端？
situation.en: My background is in backend development, but these days I'm comfortable across the whole stack.

entries.zh: 在我目前的岗位上

examples.en: In my current role, I split my time between hands-on coding and design reviews.
examples.zh: 在目前的岗位上，我的时间一部分用来写代码，一部分用来做设计评审。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你现在日常工作里写代码的比例有多大？
situation.en: In my current role, I'd say about sixty percent of my time is hands-on coding.

entries.term: What I'm looking for next is ...
entries.zh: 我下一步想找的是……

examples.en: What I'm looking for next is a role with more ownership over architecture decisions.
examples.zh: 我下一步想找的，是一个在架构决策上有更多主导权的岗位。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你为什么在看新机会？
situation.en: I've learned a lot where I am, but what I'm looking for next is a chance to work on larger-scale systems.

entries.note: 回答离职动机时，重点放在“想要什么”，而不是抱怨现在的公司。

entries.zh: 主动把……的责任担起来（含 o 开头的名词）

examples.en: I took ownership of the on-call process and cut the number of pages by half.
examples.zh: 我主动接手了值班流程，把告警呼叫次数减少了一半。

situation.zh: 面试官问：举个你主动承担职责范围之外工作的例子。
situation.en: Nobody owned our flaky test suite, so I took ownership of it and got it stable within a month.

entries.note: 比 be responsible for 更主动，强调“没人管，我来管”，高级工程师面试的高频说法。

entries.zh: 负责（形容词短语，r 开头）

examples.en: I was responsible for the design and rollout of our new authentication service.
examples.zh: 我负责新认证服务的设计和上线。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你在那个项目里具体负责哪一块？
situation.en: I was responsible for the backend API and the data model, and I also reviewed most of the frontend changes.

entries.note: 后面接名词或动名词：be responsible for designing ...。只是陈述职责，主动性不如 take ownership of。

entries.zh: 牵头发起并推动（s 开头，字面是“矛头”）

examples.en: I spearheaded the move from REST to GraphQL for our mobile clients.
examples.zh: 我牵头推动了移动端从 REST 迁到 GraphQL。

situation.zh: 面试官问：有没有哪项技术改进是你发起并推动落地的？
situation.en: Yes, I spearheaded our adoption of TypeScript, starting with a pilot in one team.

entries.note: 比 lead 更强调“由我发起”。简历和面试里常用，但别每句都用，会显得夸张。

entries.zh: 牵头推进……这项工作（含 e 开头的名词）

examples.en: I led the effort to break our monolith into independently deployable services.
examples.zh: 我牵头把我们的单体应用拆成了可以独立部署的服务。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你在那次数据库迁移里是什么角色？
situation.en: I led the effort to migrate from MySQL to Postgres, which involved coordinating four teams.

entries.note: lead 的过去式是 led，读 /led/，不要写成 lead。

entries.zh: 从头到尾全权负责……（o 开头的动词）

examples.en: I owned the notification service end to end, from design to on-call.
examples.zh: 通知服务从设计到值班，全程由我负责。

situation.zh: 面试官问：有没有哪个系统是完全由你负责的？
situation.en: Yes, I owned the search feature end to end, including the indexing pipeline and the UI.

entries.term: Let me give you a concrete example.
entries.zh: 我给你举个具体的例子。

examples.en: Let me give you a concrete example from my last project.
examples.zh: 我拿上一个项目给你举个具体的例子。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你说你擅长排查线上问题，能具体说说吗？
situation.en: Sure. Let me give you a concrete example. Last year we had a memory leak that only showed up under peak load.

entries.note: 行为题的万能开头，说完再按 STAR 展开。也可以说 a specific example。

entries.zh: 先给你交代一下背景

examples.en: To give you some context, we were a team of five supporting two million users.
examples.zh: 先交代一下背景：我们当时是五个人的团队，支撑两百万用户。

situation.zh: 面试官让你讲一个项目，你想先说明当时的团队和业务情况：
situation.en: To give you some context, this was a legacy billing system that nobody on the team had written.

entries.note: 对应 STAR 里的 Situation。背景一两句就够，别讲太久。

entries.zh: 我当时的职责是……（r 开头的名词）

examples.en: My role was to design the API and coordinate with the mobile team.
examples.zh: 我当时的职责是设计 API，并且和移动端团队对接。

situation.zh: 面试官问：那个项目有十几个人，你具体做什么？
situation.en: My role was to lead the backend work and make sure we hit the launch date.

entries.note: 对应 STAR 里的 Task。面试官最想听的是“你”做了什么，少说 we，多说 I。

entries.zh: 难点在于……（c 开头的名词）

examples.en: The challenge was that we couldn't take the system offline during the migration.
examples.zh: 难点在于迁移期间系统不能停机。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这个项目听起来不复杂，难在哪里？
situation.en: The challenge was that the data was spread across three databases with no single source of truth.

entries.term: The first thing I did was ...
entries.zh: 我做的第一件事是……

examples.en: The first thing I did was add metrics so we could see where the time went.
examples.zh: 我做的第一件事是加上指标，这样才能看出时间花在哪了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：接手一个没人了解的老系统，你是怎么开始的？
situation.en: The first thing I did was read through the incident history to find the recurring problems.

entries.note: 对应 STAR 里的 Action。was 后面直接接动词原形，to 可以省略。

entries.zh: 这里的取舍是……

examples.en: The trade-off here is that we get faster reads but writes become more expensive.
examples.zh: 这里的取舍是：读变快了，但写的成本更高。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你选择在这里做冗余存储，有什么代价？
situation.en: The trade-off here is consistency. We accept slightly stale data in exchange for much lower latency.

entries.note: 系统设计面试里最能体现资深程度的一句话：没有完美方案，只有取舍。

entries.zh: 我们选了……而不是……，因为……（o 开头的动词）

examples.en: We opted for Postgres over MongoDB because our data was highly relational.
examples.zh: 我们选了 Postgres 而不是 MongoDB，因为我们的数据关联性很强。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们当时为什么不直接上微服务？
situation.en: We opted for a modular monolith over microservices because the team was only six people.

entries.note: opt for 比 choose 稍正式，暗含“比较之后选定”。口语里也说 we went with X over Y。

entries.zh: 以……为代价（c 开头的名词）

examples.en: We got much better throughput, but at the cost of higher memory usage.
examples.zh: 吞吐量好了很多，但代价是内存占用更高。

situation.zh: 面试官问：加了这层缓存之后，有什么负面影响？
situation.en: It cut response times a lot, but at the cost of some extra complexity around invalidation.

entries.note: 近义：at the expense of。

entries.zh: 考虑到当时的限制条件

examples.en: Given the constraints, a full rewrite wasn't realistic, so we refactored incrementally.
examples.zh: 考虑到当时的限制条件，完全重写不现实，所以我们选择渐进式重构。

situation.zh: 面试官质疑：这个方案看起来不够优雅，为什么这么做？
situation.en: I agree it's not ideal, but given the constraints, mainly a three-week deadline, it was the right call.

entries.note: constraints 常指时间、人手、预算。用来解释“不完美但合理”的决定。

entries.zh: 事后看来（h 开头）

examples.en: In hindsight, we should have invested in observability much earlier.
examples.zh: 事后看来，我们应该早得多就投入做可观测性。

situation.zh: 面试官问：现在回头看，那个决定你会改吗？
situation.en: In hindsight, I would have pushed for a smaller first release instead of a big-bang launch.

entries.note: 近义：looking back。后面常接 should have / would have。

entries.zh: 把……从……降到……（b 开头的动词）

examples.en: We brought p99 latency down from 800 milliseconds to under 200.
examples.zh: 我们把 p99 延迟从 800 毫秒降到了 200 毫秒以内。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这次优化的效果怎么样？
situation.en: We brought the page load time down from six seconds to about two.

entries.note: bring 的过去式是 brought。数字要具体，面试官记得住的是数字。

entries.zh: 把……减半

examples.en: Moving to spot instances cut our compute bill in half.
examples.zh: 换成竞价实例之后，我们的计算费用减了一半。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你做的 CI 优化带来了什么改变？
situation.en: It cut our build time in half, from about twenty minutes to ten.

entries.note: cut 的过去式还是 cut。同样的意思也可以说 cut ... by 50 percent。

entries.zh: 带来（某个结果），r 开头

examples.en: The new caching layer resulted in a 40 percent drop in database load.
examples.zh: 新的缓存层让数据库负载下降了 40%。

situation.zh: 面试官问：重构结账流程之后，业务上有什么变化？
situation.en: It resulted in a 15 percent increase in conversion, which was the biggest jump that year.

entries.note: result in 接结果，result from 接原因，别弄反。对应 STAR 里的 Result。

entries.zh: 换算下来相当于、转化为（业务结果）

examples.en: That translated into roughly 20,000 dollars a month in savings.
examples.zh: 换算下来，相当于每个月省了大约两万美元。

situation.zh: 面试官问：延迟降了 100 毫秒，对业务有什么意义？
situation.en: For us, that translated into a measurable lift in checkout completion.

entries.note: 把技术指标说成业务价值时用，是高级工程师面试的加分项。也说 translate to。

entries.zh: 从……变成……（讲前后对比，g 开头的动词）

examples.en: Our deploys went from once a week to several times a day.
examples.zh: 我们的发布从每周一次变成了每天好几次。

situation.zh: 面试官问：引入自动化流水线之后，发布效率有什么变化？
situation.en: Release time went from about two hours to fifteen minutes.

entries.term: Let me think about that for a second.
entries.zh: 让我想一下这个问题。（争取几秒思考时间）

examples.en: That's a good question. Let me think about that for a second.
examples.zh: 这个问题问得好，让我想一下。

situation.zh: 面试官问了一个你没准备过的问题，你需要几秒钟组织思路：
situation.en: Hmm, let me think about that for a second. I want to pick the best example.

entries.note: 停顿几秒完全正常，比一直“嗯……呃……”好得多。

entries.term: Just to make sure I understand, ...
entries.zh: 我确认一下我理解得对不对，……

examples.en: Just to make sure I understand, you're asking how we handled failures, right?
examples.zh: 我确认一下我的理解：你是在问我们怎么处理故障，对吧？

situation.zh: 面试官的问题很长，你不确定他到底想问什么：
situation.en: Just to make sure I understand, are you asking about the technical design or how I managed the project?

entries.zh: 能不能展开讲讲……？（e 开头的动词）

examples.en: Could you elaborate on what you mean by real-time in this case?
examples.zh: 你这里说的“实时”具体指什么，能展开讲讲吗？

situation.zh: 面试官的题目里有个要求说得很模糊，你想请他多说一点：
situation.en: Could you elaborate on the consistency requirements? For example, is it okay if a user sees slightly stale data?

entries.zh: 边想边说

examples.en: I'm going to think out loud here, so feel free to stop me.
examples.zh: 我接下来会边想边说，你随时可以打断我。

situation.zh: 系统设计面试刚开始，你想告诉面试官你会把思考过程说出来：
situation.en: I'll think out loud as I go, so you can see how I'm approaching the problem.

entries.note: 面试官想看的是思路。沉默着想半天再给答案，反而扣分。也说 think aloud。

entries.term: off the top of my head
entries.zh: 凭印象、不查资料直接说（字面：头顶）

examples.en: Off the top of my head, I'd say we handled around 5,000 requests per second.
examples.zh: 凭印象说，我们大概每秒处理 5000 个请求。

situation.zh: 面试官问：那个服务的错误率大概是多少？你记不清确切数字：
situation.en: I don't remember the exact number, but off the top of my head, it was well under one percent.

entries.note: 给不确定的数字时先说这句，表示“大概如此，可能不精确”。

entries.zh: 它一开始只是……（s 开头的动词短语）

examples.en: It started out as a simple cron job that ran once a night.
examples.zh: 它一开始只是一个每晚跑一次的 cron 任务。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这个数据平台是怎么发展起来的？
situation.en: It started out as a single script, and over two years it grew into a full pipeline.

entries.zh: 规模增长到原有方案不够用（一个词，o 开头）

examples.en: Within a year we had outgrown the single database instance.
examples.zh: 不到一年，单个数据库实例就撑不住我们的规模了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们为什么要换掉原来的消息队列？
situation.en: We had simply outgrown it. It was fine at a thousand messages a second, but not at fifty thousand.

entries.note: 主语是人或团队，宾语是旧方案：we outgrew the old design。过去式 outgrew，过去分词 outgrown。

entries.zh: 后来情况很明显：……（b 开头的动词）

examples.en: It became clear that the nightly batch job couldn't keep up with the data volume.
examples.zh: 后来情况很明显：每晚的批处理任务已经跟不上数据量了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们是什么时候决定重构的？
situation.en: After the third outage in a month, it became clear that patching the old system wasn't sustainable.

entries.zh: 转折点是……

examples.en: The turning point was a Black Friday outage that cost us six hours of sales.
examples.zh: 转折点是黑色星期五那次故障，让我们损失了六个小时的销售额。

situation.zh: 面试官问：是什么让管理层同意投入做这次重构的？
situation.en: The turning point was when a single bad deploy took down checkout for an hour.

entries.zh: （几经周折）最终……，两个词，e 开头

examples.en: We tried tuning the queries first, but we ended up adding a read replica.
examples.zh: 我们先试了优化查询，但最终还是加了一个只读副本。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你们评估了三个方案，最后选了哪个？
situation.en: We ended up going with the simplest one, because it was the easiest to operate.

entries.note: 后面接动名词：end up doing。常暗含“和最初的打算不一样”。

entries.term: Let me start by clarifying the requirements.
entries.zh: 我先来澄清一下需求。

examples.en: Before I draw anything, let me start by clarifying the requirements.
examples.zh: 在画图之前，我先澄清一下需求。

situation.zh: 面试官说：请设计一个短链接服务。你不想马上开始画架构图：
situation.en: Sure. Let me start by clarifying the requirements. Who are the users, and what are the main features?

entries.note: 系统设计面试的标准第一步。一上来就画图是最常见的扣分点。

entries.term: What scale are we designing for?
entries.zh: 我们要按多大的规模来设计？

examples.en: What scale are we designing for? Thousands of users, or millions?
examples.zh: 我们要按多大的规模来设计？几千用户，还是几百万？

situation.zh: 系统设计面试里，你想知道用户量和请求量的量级：
situation.en: One more question: what scale are we designing for? Roughly how many daily active users?

entries.term: Is it safe to assume that ...?
entries.zh: 我可以放心地假设……吗？（s 开头的形容词）

examples.en: Is it safe to assume that reads far outnumber writes in this system?
examples.zh: 我可以假设这个系统的读远多于写吗？

situation.zh: 设计一个信息流系统时，你想确认一个前提再往下讲：
situation.en: Is it safe to assume that users can tolerate a few seconds of delay before a new post shows up?

entries.note: 把假设说出来让面试官确认，比默默假设好得多。

entries.term: I'll leave ... out of scope for now.
entries.zh: 我先把……放在讨论范围之外。

examples.en: I'll leave analytics out of scope for now and focus on the core flow.
examples.zh: 我先不考虑数据分析这块，集中讲核心流程。

situation.zh: 设计聊天系统时，你想先不讨论音视频通话：
situation.en: I'll leave voice and video calls out of scope for now, unless you'd like me to cover them.

entries.zh: 核心使用场景、核心用例

examples.en: I'd like to focus on two core use cases: posting a message and reading the feed.
examples.zh: 我想集中讲两个核心场景：发消息和读信息流。

situation.zh: 面试官给的题目范围很大，你想先圈定最重要的几个功能：
situation.en: Let me list the core use cases first, and then we can decide which ones to go deep on.

entries.zh: 大致的数字、粗略的估计值（字面和“球场”有关）

examples.en: Let me work out a ballpark figure for the storage we need.
examples.zh: 我来估一个我们所需存储的大致数字。

situation.zh: 澄清完需求后，你想先快速估一下每天的请求量：
situation.en: Before the design, let me get a ballpark figure for traffic. Say ten million users, each making twenty requests a day.

entries.note: 估算只要量级对，不用精确。也可以单说 a ballpark：just a ballpark。

entries.zh: 大约在……这个量级

examples.en: We're looking at on the order of 10,000 writes per second at peak.
examples.zh: 高峰期的写入大约在每秒一万次这个量级。

situation.zh: 面试官问：这个系统一年大概会产生多少数据？
situation.en: With these numbers, it's on the order of a few terabytes a year, so a single cluster is enough.

entries.note: 注意和 in order to（为了）区分。

entries.term: Let me sketch out a high-level design first.
entries.zh: 我先画一个总体设计。

examples.en: Let me sketch out a high-level design first, and then we can go into details.
examples.zh: 我先画一个总体设计，然后我们再看细节。

situation.zh: 需求和规模都确认了，你准备开始在白板上画架构：
situation.en: Okay, let me sketch out a high-level design first. I'll start with the client and work my way back.

entries.zh: 我带你过一遍……

examples.en: Let me walk you through what happens when a user uploads a photo.
examples.zh: 我带你过一遍用户上传一张照片时发生了什么。

situation.zh: 画完架构图后，你想沿着一次请求的路径讲解各个组件：
situation.en: Let me walk you through the write path, from the API gateway all the way to storage.

entries.zh: 从总体上讲、不涉及细节地说

examples.en: At a high level, there are three parts: ingestion, processing, and serving.
examples.zh: 总体上分三部分：接入、处理和对外服务。

situation.zh: 面试官问：能不能用一两句话概括你们的系统架构？
situation.en: At a high level, it's an event-driven system with a few services communicating through a message queue.

entries.zh: 我对……提出了反对，因为……（p 开头的动词短语）

examples.en: I pushed back on the deadline because we hadn't finished load testing.
examples.zh: 我对这个期限提出了反对，因为压测还没做完。

situation.zh: 面试官问：有没有你不同意产品经理要求的时候？
situation.en: Yes. I pushed back on launching without a rollback plan because the risk to payments was too high.

entries.note: push back 不是吵架，而是有理有据地表示不同意，所以一定要带上 because。

entries.zh: 看法一致（常用于否定句，字面：眼对眼）

examples.en: My tech lead and I didn't see eye to eye on the database choice.
examples.zh: 我和技术负责人在数据库选型上意见不一致。

situation.zh: 面试官问：讲一次你和同事意见不合的经历。
situation.en: Early on, a senior colleague and I didn't see eye to eye on how to split the services.

entries.note: 搭配：see eye to eye with 某人 on 某事。比 we disagreed 更委婉。

entries.zh: 耐心听……把话说完

examples.en: I asked him to walk me through his concerns and heard him out.
examples.zh: 我请他把顾虑讲一遍，并耐心听他说完。

situation.zh: 面试官问：对方强烈反对你的方案时，你第一步怎么做？
situation.en: First I hear them out, because often they've seen a risk that I missed.

entries.zh: 找到双方的共同点

examples.en: We found common ground once we agreed that reliability mattered more than speed.
examples.zh: 当我们都认同稳定性比速度更重要之后，就找到了共同点。

situation.zh: 面试官问：最后你们是怎么解决分歧的？
situation.en: We tried to find common ground first. We both wanted fewer incidents, we just disagreed on how.

entries.zh: 保留不同意见，但全力执行决定

examples.en: I still preferred my approach, but I decided to disagree and commit.
examples.zh: 我还是更倾向自己的方案，但我决定保留意见、全力执行。

situation.zh: 面试官问：如果团队最终没采纳你的方案，你会怎么做？
situation.en: Once the decision is made, I disagree and commit. I say my piece, and then I fully support the plan.

entries.note: Amazon 的领导力准则里有这一条，英文面试里很常见。
